label.description: Human label for the payment (handler or profile label).

amount_btc.description: Amount in BTC, for BTC payments.

btc_address.description: Destination address. Payee detail, never identity: many payments share one address.

txid.description: On-chain transaction id, for BTC payments.

status.description: Outcome status reported by the rail (e.g. sent, failed).

payment_date.description: Date the payment was made. Part of every identity rule.

memo_policy.description: Memo/OP_RETURN policy applied (BTC payments carry none).

approval_id.description: Entity id of the payment_approval record that authorized this payment. Primary identity with payment_date.

session_keys.description: Calendar session keys (handler:event_id) this payment covers.

primary_session_key.description: First entry of session_keys. Scalar copy so it can sit in the fallback identity rule with payment_date when there is no approval_id.
